name: humanizer-de
tagline_zh: 给德语稿子做整容：先测腔调节奏，再按证据改稿，最后揪出AI惯用套路。专治一眼假的机器翻译腔，改完像人写的。
tagline_en: German text too robotic? Measure tone & rhythm, edit with evidence, then strip AI tells. Make it read human—not.
desc_en: Edit-Pass für bestehenden deutschen Text: Register/Rhythmus messen, belegtreu redigieren, Naturalness prüfen, KI-Schreibmuster/KI-Tells auditieren und entfernen; deutschen Text humanisieren; German AI Text Humanizer.
why_zh: 同类只换词，它先量化腔调再动刀，连AI惯用句式都标出来，改完有据可查。
why_en: Unlike paraphrasers, it audits tone metrics and flags AI tells before editing—so every change is evidence-based, not guesswork.
